title: Northgate Cash Earning Schedule by Tier
content:
Northgate Cash is the reward currency of **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships**. This schedule sets, for each tier, the earn rate, the yearly earning cap, the purchases that never earn, when earnings post, how amounts are rounded and how returns affect the balance.

| Tier | Earn rate (percent of eligible net merchandise amount) | Annual earn cap (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards | 1 | no cap |
| Northgate+ Assist | 1 | no cap |
| Northgate+ Student | 1 | no cap |
| Northgate+ Monthly | 1 | no cap |
| Northgate+ Annual | 1 | no cap |
| Northgate+ Business | 2 | 500.00 |

**Terms common to every tier**

| Term | Setting on every tier |
|---|---|
| Purchase types that never earn | gift cards, membership fees, protection plans, alcohol, prescriptions, marketplace items |
| When earned Cash posts | on the date the order line is fulfilled |
| Rounding of each earned or reversed amount | half up to the cent |
| Cash earned on a returned or refunded line is reversed | yes |
| A reversal larger than the current balance may take the balance below zero (netted by later earnings) | yes |

**Definitions**

- The *earn rate* is the Northgate Cash earned as a percentage of the eligible net merchandise amount.
- The *annual earn cap* is the maximum Northgate Cash earned per calendar year, in US dollars; no cap means unlimited.

**Illustration of the rate (hypothetical amount)**

On an eligible net merchandise amount of 300.00, an earn rate of 1 percent corresponds to 3.00 of Northgate Cash and an earn rate of 2 percent to 6.00, each rounded half up to the cent.
